notes: Framework content is preserved from the agreed Project Framework workbook; this file normalizes app-selectable records.
Additional indicators are stored one record per selectable indicator.
Suggested activities are stored one record per selectable activity. Clear concatenated/list packages were split without introducing new thematic concepts.
Standard primary indicators remain mandatory. Additional indicators remain optional/selectable.
Framework provenance is admin metadata and should not be displayed to normal app users.
Every Final Outcome–Pathway relationship now includes explicit pathwayRelationshipType: primary or related.
Primary means the pathway is directly linked to the Final Outcome in the agreed Project Framework Master structure.
Related means the pathway can reinforce/contribute to the Final Outcome but is not a direct Master-framework pathway for that outcome.
Community-based extension and peer learning is explicitly available as a Related pathway for every Final Outcome where it is not already Primary.
The app must require at least one Primary pathway for every selected Final Outcome; Related pathways are optional and cannot satisfy that rule alone.
